title: The Abandoned Delve
objective: Loot the old dungeon under the ruined keep and get out alive, by the gate or the shaft.

rooms.name: Broken Gate
rooms.description: A cracked stair runs down from the ruined keep to a gate hanging off its hinges. Daylight is at your back. Someone has chalked marks on the gatepost.

features.name: Chalk Marks
features.description: Faded chalk marks left by an earlier treasure-hunter.
features.discovery: The marks read: "Dead man in the guard post. Wire on the shrine stair. Key on the altar opens the vault. Webs: keep out."

rooms.name: Gate Hall
rooms.description: A long hall of fallen banners. A swollen door stands shut in one wall, bones clatter somewhere behind the barracks arch, and a passage leads to the guard post.

rooms.name: Guard Post
rooms.description: A cramped guard room with a weapon rack and an overturned table. A dead guard still stands its post, a purse at its belt. A narrow way leads on to an old well.

features.name: Weapon Rack
features.discovery: Tucked behind the spears is a stoppered vial of red liquid.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Guard's Purse
items.description: A leather purse of old silver coins.

rooms.name: Barracks
rooms.description: Rows of collapsed bunks. Two skeletons in rusted mail stand guard here still, beside a footlocker at the end of the room.

features.name: Footlocker
features.description: An iron-bound footlocker, its lid rusted half open.
features.discovery: Wrapped in a mouldy cloak is a dagger hilt chased with silver.

items.name: Dagger Hilt
items.description: A dagger hilt chased with silver, its blade long gone.

rooms.name: Storeroom
rooms.description: A dry storeroom of split barrels and empty shelves. One old barrel is still sealed.

features.name: Old Barrel
features.discovery: Packed in straw inside the barrel are a stoppered vial of red liquid, an oiled longsword and a shield.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A stoppered vial of red liquid that glimmers when shaken.

items.name: Oiled Shortsword
items.description: A plain shortsword wrapped in oilcloth, its edge still keen.

items.name: Storeroom Shield
items.description: A wooden shield rimmed with iron, packed away and never used.

rooms.name: Dry Well
rooms.description: A round chamber around a dry well. A goblin is stuck at the bottom and calls up to you. A stair leads down to a shrine, and a webbed passage to a crypt.

creatures.name: Goblin
creatures.description: A scrawny goblin wedged at the bottom of the well, too frightened of the dead to climb out.

topics.name: the vault
topics.reply: "The dead never left. Bones in the barracks, a big spider in the crypt, and a dead thing in the vault past the shaft. The vault key? On the altar in the shrine."

topics.name: the stair
topics.reply: "Fine, fine. There's a loose step on the shrine stair. Step on it and the stair drops you. Look before you walk."
topics.failure: "Get me out first, then I'll tell you things." The goblin sulks.

rooms.name: Shrine
rooms.description: A small shrine at the foot of the stair. Silver candlesticks stand on a stone altar. A passage runs on to a shaft of daylight.

features.name: Altar
features.description: A stone altar with two tarnished silver candlesticks.
features.discovery: Behind the candlesticks lies a heavy bronze key.

items.name: Bronze Key
items.description: A heavy bronze key stamped with a lord's crest.

items.name: Candlesticks
items.description: A pair of tarnished silver candlesticks.

rooms.name: Web Crypt
rooms.description: Thick webs fill a low crypt. A cocooned body hangs in the middle, and something large shifts in the dark above it.

features.name: Cocoon
features.description: A body wrapped in web, hanging from the ceiling.
features.discovery: On the dead treasure-hunter's hand is a gold ring.

items.name: Gold Ring
items.description: A heavy gold ring set with a red stone.

rooms.name: Shaft Bottom
rooms.description: The bottom of a collapsed shaft, lit by daylight far above. A knotted rope hangs down: you could climb out with what you carry. Beside it a bronze door leads to the vault.

features.name: Knotted Rope
features.description: A knotted rope, tied off somewhere far above.
features.discovery: The rope is sound. It would take your weight to the surface.

rooms.name: Vault
rooms.description: The lord's vault: a stone room with an iron chest against the far wall. Something that was once a man crouches over it.

features.name: Iron Chest
features.description: A great iron chest, its lid broken open.
features.discovery: The chest is still half full of old gold coins.

items.name: Gold Coins
items.description: Handfuls of old gold coins stamped with a forgotten lord's face.

items.name: Goblet
items.description: A jewelled gold goblet the ghoul clutched to its chest.

passages.description: A short passage to the guard post.
An arch. Bones clatter beyond it.

door.name: Swollen Door
door.description: The damp wood has swollen tight in its frame.

passages.description: A narrow way to the well.
A worn stair down to the shrine.

trap.name: Loose Step
trap.description: One step is set loose over a drop, wired to give way.
trap.trigger: A step gives way and the stair drops you down onto broken stone.

passages.description: A passage choked with webs. Something big lives in there.
A gap torn through the webs.

door.name: Vault Door
door.description: A bronze door stamped with a lord's crest, locked fast.

opponents.description: The dead guard turns, jaw hanging, and shambles at you.

opponents.name: Tall Skeleton
opponents.description: A tall skeleton in rusted mail raises a shortsword.

opponents.name: Bent Skeleton
opponents.description: A bent skeleton clatters up from a bunk beside it.
A spider the size of a pony drops from the webs, fangs dripping.
The ghoul looks up from the chest, a jewelled goblet in its claws, and springs.

endings.title: Out with the loot
endings.text: You climb back into the daylight with the dungeon's treasure on your back.

endings.title: Out empty-handed
endings.text: You climb back into the daylight alive, with nothing to show for it.

endings.title: Lost in the delve
endings.text: You fall in the dark under the ruined keep, and the dead keep you. Your adventuring ends here.
